## Testing Mode
RED

## Story DD Coverage
- dd-3: Verification harness asserts git ls-files on scratch path returns empty even when scratch contents exist on disk

## Description
Create tests/scratch/test-scratch-gitignore.sh. Init tickets-tracker, write sentinel at .tickets-tracker/.scratch/sentinel.txt, run `git ls-files .tickets-tracker/.scratch/` on tickets branch and assert empty. Also assert `git check-ignore -v` reports the path ignored via .git/info/exclude. Must FAIL before task-3.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] bash tests/run-all.sh exits 0
  Verify: bash tests/run-all.sh
- [ ] Lint passes
  Verify: ruff check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py
- [ ] Test executable
  Verify: test -x tests/scratch/test-scratch-gitignore.sh
- [ ] Test FAILS pre-implementation (RED)
  Verify: bash tests/scratch/test-scratch-gitignore.sh; [ $? -ne 0 ]
- [ ] Test asserts both git ls-files empty AND git check-ignore matches
  Verify: grep -q 'git ls-files' tests/scratch/test-scratch-gitignore.sh && grep -q 'git check-ignore' tests/scratch/test-scratch-gitignore.sh

## File Impact
| Path | Action |
|---|---|
| tests/scratch/test-scratch-gitignore.sh | Create |

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 sonnet → opus → user.
